description: PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk engages in the coal mining activities. The company is also involved in the logistics business, which includes coal barging and transshipment, fuel oil transportation and management, river channel management and dredging, multipurpose terminal and stockpile management, stevedoring, and shipyard operations. In addition, it engages in construction, operation, and maintenance of drinking water supply system; mine water pumping and processing operations; water treatment and water solution business; and lease of powerplant and supporting activities. Further, the company is involved in forestry business; port; manufacture, repair, and maintenance of sea transportation; trading, handling, and barging of coal; sea transportation; and investment activities, as well as provision of terminal handling and mining support services. PT Adaro Andalan Indonesia Tbk was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
